title: Maybe Chaos Is Also Home
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

human_truth: After a day that makes him want silence, Zuv does not smile because the stress vanished; he smiles because he remembers Aachu's warm little chaos waiting at home, and that chaos is the safest place to land.
emotional_arc: bad-workday universal hook -> Aachu waiting as warm chaos -> chai/drama/long-story proof -> Zuv's parked-car smile and active choice -> chaos-as-home thesis
source_story_summary: Selected concept from the Golden Theme tournament: Maybe Chaos Is Also Home. Universal relationship truth: some days make him want silence, but the person waiting at home can make even warm chaos feel safe. Himanshu has a bad work day, sits in his parked car, remembers Aachu waiting at home with chai, drama, and one long story, then smiles before driving home. Public slide copy must be exactly: Slide 1: Some days make him want silence. Slide 2: Then he remembers her waiting. Slide 3: Chai. Drama. One long story. Slide 4: And he smiles before home. Slide 5: Maybe chaos is also home.
visual_style: soft romantic archive, hand-drawn desi storybook illustration, warm paper, expressive but tender, no office-corporate slickness, no photo/glow/aesthetic-first framing
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

concept_selection.source: Golden Theme variant tournament against Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles.
concept_selection.selector_verdict: Winner keeps the gold carousel machine while shifting into Himanshu POV: the universal tension is wanting silence after work, the Aachu proof is chai/drama/one long story, the Zuv role is his active smile and choice to return to that warm chaos, and the thesis is sendable.
concept_selection.calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the first-principles insight that Aachu's expressive energy becomes lovable because Zuv treats it as safety instead of noise.
final_public_slide_copy_direction: Some days make him want silence.

candidates.name: Maybe Chaos Is Also Home
candidates.universal_truth: After a draining day, the right person is not always quiet; sometimes their lovable chaos is the safe landing.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu waiting with chai, drama, and one long story.
candidates.concrete_proof: Zuv in the parked car, phone lighting up with ghar aa jao?, and his face softening before he drives.
candidates.zuv_role: He chooses the warm noise instead of escaping into silence.

candidates.name: Some Days Need Her Noise
candidates.universal_truth: The day makes him crave quiet, but love has taught him which noise heals him.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Her voice note, chai, and running commentary become the reward at the end of work.
candidates.concrete_proof: Tired car seat, phone notification, voice note bubble, soft smile.
candidates.zuv_role: His smile is the active choice to return to her world.
candidates.tender_thesis: Some noise brings you back to yourself.

candidates.name: His Smile Started Before Home
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes love begins helping before you even reach the door.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's tiny text and waiting-at-home warmth reach him inside the car.
candidates.concrete_proof: The smile arrives before the drive starts.
candidates.zuv_role: He lets himself be softened by the thought of her.
candidates.tender_thesis: Home can start in the heart before the house.

candidates.name: The Phone Changed The Car
candidates.universal_truth: One message can make the whole day feel survivable.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's ghar aa jao? carries care, impatience, and soft drama.
candidates.concrete_proof: Phone glow in a parked car after office.
candidates.zuv_role: He receives the care and decides to go home lighter.
candidates.tender_thesis: The smallest message can become a doorway.

candidates.name: Chai Before The Debrief
candidates.universal_truth: Some people know how to receive your tiredness before asking for the story.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu has chai ready and still has her own full story waiting.
candidates.concrete_proof: Doorway, two cups, his office bag, her expressive waiting face.
candidates.zuv_role: He lets home hold him without needing to explain everything first.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is knowing where the day can finally exhale.

candidates.name: Bad Day, Good Door
candidates.universal_truth: A bad day feels smaller when the right door is waiting.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu is behind the door with warmth, chai, and small chaos.
candidates.concrete_proof: Office bag at the threshold, keys, slippers, two cups.
candidates.zuv_role: He returns to the place where he can stop performing.
candidates.tender_thesis: The right door is a person.
